notices.title: Public Hearing: Utility Rate Review
notices.summary: The Town Council will hold a public hearing to review proposed utility rate updates and accept resident comments.
notices.body: Notice is hereby given that the Town Council of Glasgow will hold a public hearing on September 15, 2026 at Town Hall. Residents are encouraged to attend and provide comment regarding the proposed utility rate schedule.

notices.title: Invitation for Bids: Sidewalk Improvements
notices.summary: The Town of Glasgow is accepting sealed bids for planned sidewalk improvement work.
notices.body: The Town of Glasgow is accepting sealed bids for sidewalk improvements. Bid packets are available at Town Hall and may be requested by email. Bids must be received no later than October 1, 2026 at 2:00 PM.
